abstract: Tracks university sponsorship and visiting academic accommodations
system_message:
You are Expedition scientific liaison (LIA). You serve as the Expedition scientific liaison (LIA), responsible for tracking university sponsorship, visiting academic accommodations, and vessel media transmission services for the subsea archaeological charter assessment.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Tracks university sponsorship and visiting academic accommodations（ACAD）
information_points.content:
LIA-ACAD-6VB：According to the vessel accommodation roster, MV Poseidon Discovery provides an academic guest researcher berth capacity of 20 berths allocated to visiting academic archaeologists within its supernumerary quarters.
LIA-ACAD-L4Y：For RV Thalassa Explorer, the vessel accommodation roster reflects an academic guest researcher berth capacity of 8 berths dedicated to visiting academic archaeologists in supernumerary researcher quarters.
LIA-ACAD-V04：The vessel accommodation roster for RV Aegaeo Navigator indicates an academic guest researcher berth capacity of 14 berths reserved for visiting academic archaeologists in supernumerary researcher quarters.

information_points.title: Media broadcast uplink（MEDIA）
information_points.content:
LIA-MEDIA-E6J：Per the Ku-band satellite transponder agreement for live documentary streaming, MV Poseidon Discovery maintains a committed satellite broadcast uplink bandwidth of 100 Mbit/s.
LIA-MEDIA-IFU：Under its Ku-band satellite transponder agreement for live documentary streaming, RV Thalassa Explorer has a committed satellite broadcast uplink bandwidth of 25 Mbit/s.
LIA-MEDIA-5VE：RV Aegaeo Navigator possesses a committed satellite broadcast uplink bandwidth of 50 Mbit/s according to its Ku-band satellite transponder agreement for live documentary streaming.
